## Trust boundaries

| ID | Between | Enforced by | State | Observation |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| TB-1 | Internet (Z0) <-> Enterprise (Z1) | Perimeter firewall | Enforced | Standard IT perimeter; email and web filtering in place. |
| TB-2 | Enterprise (Z1) <-> Industrial DMZ (Z2) | IT/OT firewall (IT-facing leg) | Partially enforced | Three-legged firewall managed by IT. Rule base contains 'temporary' any-any rule from 2024 robot-cell project and direct RDP/SMB from the IT admin subnet. |
| TB-3 | Industrial DMZ (Z2) <-> OT Site Operations (Z3) | IT/OT firewall (OT-facing leg) | Partially enforced | Historian replication is bidirectional SQL; AD authentication traffic passes from OT hosts straight to corporate domain controllers, bypassing the DMZ. |
| TB-4 | OT Site Operations (Z3) <-> Control (Z4) | None (routed on OT core switch, no ACLs) | Not enforced | Any OT host can reach any PLC on any port. PLCs are left in REMOTE key position. |
| TB-5 | Control (Z4) <-> Physical Process & Safety (Z5) | Hardwired I/O; independent hardwired safety circuits | Physically enforced | Safety functions (e-stop, light curtains, door interlocks) are hardwired and not programmable from the network - assumed independent of PLC logic. |
| TB-6 | OT (Z3) <-> IIoT / Cloud (Z6) | None by Apex (LTE router supplied by IIoT vendor) | Not enforced | IIoT gateway is dual-homed: OT network + its own LTE uplink to the Internet. This path bypasses the IDMZ entirely. |
| TB-7 | Vendor (Z7) <-> Apex (Z2/Z3) | SSL VPN + contract | Weak | Single shared vendor VPN account, password-only, always enabled. TeamViewer found installed on the engineering workstation as an 'emergency' path. |
